notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 16th
notes.content:
General bug fixes
 - Changed ray cast method loop to avoid unwanted clipping (When you look at Karen she actually stops moving now)
 - Removed dual monitor bug where cursor would leave game window
 - Removed achievement errors
 
Other Changes
 - Added return to menu button when you lose
 - Changed flashlight power to a physics loop (Flashlight won't run out really fast on high performance machines)
